decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY retaining the individual JST architecture and disallowing a fan-out ribbon connector, so no additional or edited Event is needed.
The source changes the main-board outline and connector architecture; it does not change the sensor board's existing orientation, connector alignment, or bottom-side placement policy.
The requested 140×100 dimensions, rough rearrangement, individual JST retention, and ESP32 edge placement apply to the main board, not the power-board mechanical layout.
Retaining individual JST connectors does not change the established panel-control functions, GPIO mappings, or through-connector connection mode.
The mechanical resize, connector architecture decision, and ESP32 edge placement do not alter any ESP32 GPIO assignment.
The source does not change the monitoring IC, monitored rails, monitor position, or current-coverage behavior.
The source concerns board mechanics and connector organization and does not change the power-source OR-ing method or source-selection behavior.
Keeping the ESP32 at the board edge does not change the requirement to expose currently unused ESP32 pins through through-holes.
The main-board resize and connector decision do not modify the I2C series-resistor value, population policy, purpose, or topology.
The source does not change the power-board DCDC1 voltage, configuration interface, downstream target, or diode-drop compensation.
The board-layout and connector-architecture decision does not change the passive buzzer specification or accepted part.
The source does not remove or modify the requirement for main-board decoupling capacitors.
